events.name: SkyTrail Festival
events.summary: Hosted by the Calhoun County Area Chamber. Calhoun County's first birding festival. Friday welcome at the Sensory Garden at Longleaf Center, 5:30-7 p.m. ($25, registration required). Saturday guided walks at Choccolocco Park in Oxford, 8-11 a.m.

events.name: The Aisle: Anniston Bridal Show
events.summary: Sunday, Oct. 18, at the Longleaf Event Center. Register free in advance; $25 at the door; VIP $75. Founded by Matt Headley, who writes Southern Legends.
